Is it just me or do others feel that the horse racing in the game is subpar at best? The handling on the horse around any static game objects (trees, fences, BRIDGES, tall rocks, sign posts etc) is abysmal and causes you to stop in your tracks allowing the NPCs to pass you. Granted there is a Mario Kart effect where the leader can only distance himself so much from the riders behind them, but the immersion is totally broken, and any race that has a bridge in the last 300ft is unbelievably frustrating to win. This is the only time I've used quicksaves to alter an outcome. I've yet to reload a save to change a decision outside of being cheated from a racing victory.

When you compare racing to gwent (which is the best side game I've ever seen in the series) it almost seems as though the devs implemented racing only to hand out upgrade gear for your steed.

While I could easily ignore racing quests I stubbornly won't due to the fact that every other second I spend in the game is phenomenal, and part of me continues hoping I just haven't gotten the mechanics down yet, though that is a fallacy.

With all that said, this is the most addictive, rewarding game I can recall in recent years, and I'll likely replay sometime soon. Kudos CDPR you are a master craftsman in gaming.
